name: hud_cmd_dialog_destructor
description: HudCmdDialog::Destructor tears down the command dialog child panels, simple buttons, set-list widget, command/key/joy/mouse binding buttons, and finally the HudUiBackground base.
known_limits: VC byte verification does not currently match: VC5SP3 vc5_o2_ob0_facs failed for 0x40adf0 with 606 unmasked mismatches after masking 60 relocation bytes and trimming 6 NOPs. The current source uses file-local helpers for repeated binding-button cleanup while the original destructor is EH-expanded inline cleanup.
functional_evidence: Native smoke constructs a HudCmdDialog with runtime-heavy constructor calls patched to probes, installs command/key/joy/mouse binding entries, runs the real destructor, and verifies the five binding vectors are released/reset.

Current Binary Ninja disassembly for 0x40adf0 shows reverse construction-order teardown from description/prompt panels through set/simple buttons, five binding-button subobjects, and the HudUiBackground base.
